series.name: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 (US residential string inverter, numbered alarm table)
series.notes: Separate table from SERIES 1 - same numeric codes, different severity and different cause/suggestion text. Codes unique to this table: 2021, 2068, 2077, 2080. CONFLICTS: 2063 Overtemperature is Major here vs Minor in M0 (SERIES 1); 2065 Upgrade Failed is Major here vs Minor in M0. This block is a DELIBERATE SUBSET of Table 8-2: only the rows that either (a) exist nowhere in SERIES 1, or (b) differ from SERIES 1 in severity, action or Cause-ID semantics, are carried. The USL0 rows 2033/2034/2035/2036/2037/2039/2040/2051/2061/2062/61440 are present in this same USL0 table but carry wording identical in substance to SERIES 1, so they are represented once in SERIES 1 and are NOT duplicated here - this is deduplication, not merging, and the two tables remain separate records. title.ur: AFCI self-check failure (arc detector khud check nahi kar paya)

meaning.en: The inverter's AFCI (arc fault circuit interrupter) failed its self-check at startup, so the unit shuts down.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka AFCI startup par self-check mein fail ho gaya, is liye unit shutdown ho jata hai.

causes.en: AFCI self-check fails (Cause ID 1-2).
causes.ur: AFCI self-check fail ho gaya (Cause ID 1-2).

causes.en: AFCI detector module or its wiring is faulty, or PV-side noise triggered a false trip.
causes.ur: AFCI detector module ya uski wiring kharabi hai, ya PV side ke noise se false trip hua hai.

solutions.en: Turn off the AC output switch and the DC input switch, then wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: AC output switch aur DC input switch band karein, phir 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Turn them back on and watch whether the AFCI self-check completes on the next start.
solutions.ur: Dobara on karein aur dekhein ke next start par AFCI self-check complete hoti hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it persists, inspect PV string cables for chafing near the combiner and record the Cause ID for the installer.
solutions.ur: Agar bani rahe to combiner ke paas PV string cables ki chafing check karein aur installer ke liye Cause ID note karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Section 8.2 Table 8-2

aliases: DC Arc Fault (ADMC alarm, need to be manually cleared)

title.ur: DC arc fault (manually clear karna hota hai)

meaning.en: PV string power cable arcs or is in poor contact. This is an ADMC alarm - after fixing, it must be manually cleared.
meaning.ur: PV string power cable mein arc ya poor contact hai. Yeh ADMC alarm hai - theek karne ke baad manually clear karna hota hai.

causes.en: The PV string power cable arcs or is in poor contact.
causes.ur: PV string power cable mein arc ya poor contact hai.

causes.en: Cause ID 1 = string 1, Cause ID 2 = string 2 (this model's Cause IDs are per-string, unlike M0's per-MPPT).
causes.ur: Is model mein Cause ID 1 = string 1, Cause ID 2 = string 2 (M0 ke per-MPPT ke bajaye per-string).

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV before inspecting; treat as a live arc risk, not a nuisance alarm.
solutions.ur: Ghairat ka masla hai, is liye AC aur PV disconnect kar ke hi inspect karein.

solutions.en: Check every string circuit for arcing or poor contact, including combiner fuses and cable gland entries.
solutions.ur: Har string circuit mein arc ya poor contact check karein, combiner fuses aur cable gland entries bhi.

solutions.en: After the fault is rectified, clear the alarm manually in the app and start the inverter again.
solutions.ur: Fault theek hone ke baad app mein alarm manually clear karein aur inverter dobara start karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Section 8.2 Table 8-2

title.ur: Grid failure (grid ya AC nahi hai)

meaning.en: Grid outage, or the AC circuit is disconnected / AC switch off. Shutdown with automatic recovery.
meaning.ur: Grid outage hai, ya AC circuit disconnect hai / AC switch off hai. Shutdown ke saath khud recover hota hai.

causes.en: The power grid experiences an outage (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Power grid mein outage hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: The AC circuit is disconnected or the AC switch is in the OFF position.
causes.ur: AC circuit disconnect hai ya AC switch OFF position mein hai.

solutions.en: Check the AC voltage with a multimeter at the inverter AC terminals.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se inverter ke AC terminals par AC voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the AC power cable is connected and the AC switch is in the ON position.
solutions.ur: Tasdeeq karein ke AC power cable connected hai aur AC switch ON position mein hai.

solutions.en: If the utility side is fine but the alarm repeats, check the AC cable for a high-resistance joint at the lug.
solutions.ur: Agar utility side theek hai lekin alarm dohraye to AC cable ke lug par high-resistance joint check karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Section 8.2 Table 8-2

meaning.en: Inverter internal temperature high - poor ventilation, ambient above the upper threshold, or unit not working properly. This manual grades it Major, unlike the M0 manual which grades it Minor.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka andar ka temperature zyada hai - ventilation kam, ambient upper threshold se upar, ya unit theek nahi chal raha. Ye manual ise Major grade karta hai, M0 manual Minor karta hai.

causes.en: The SUN2000 is installed in a place with poor ventilation.
causes.ur: SUN2000 kam ventilation wali jagah lagai hai.

causes.en: The ambient temperature exceeds the upper threshold.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature upper threshold se zyada hai.

causes.en: The SUN2000 is not working properly (internal fault).
causes.ur: SUN2000 theek nahi chal raha (internal fault).

solutions.en: Check the ventilation and ambient temperature at the installation position.
solutions.ur: Installation position par ventilation aur ambient temperature check karein.

solutions.en: If ventilation is poor or ambient is above the threshold, improve ventilation and heat dissipation before anything else.
solutions.ur: Agar ventilation kam hai ya ambient threshold se upar hai to pehle ventilation aur heat dissipation behtar karein.

solutions.en: If both meet requirements, contact your installer - this points to an internal fault.
solutions.ur: Agar dono requirements meet karte hain to installer se rabta karein - yeh internal fault ki nishani hai.

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Section 8.2 Table 8-2

meaning.en: An unrecoverable fault on an internal circuit. Cause ID 3,4 auto-recover; 5,6-7,14 need manual reset; 8-13 shut down and auto-recover.
meaning.ur: Internal circuit par unrecoverable fault. Cause ID 3,4 khud recover hote hain; 5, 6-7, 14 manual reset maangte hain; 8-13 shutdown karke khud recover hote hain.

causes.en: Unrecoverable fault on a circuit inside the SUN2000 (Cause ID 3 through 14).
causes.ur: SUN2000 ke andar kisi circuit par unrecoverable fault (Cause ID 3 se 14 tak).

causes.en: Two failure modes share this one cause text: transient faults (Cause ID 3, 4, 8-13) clear themselves, while latched faults (Cause ID 5, 6-7, 14) need a manual alarm reset.
causes.ur: Ek hi cause text ke neeche do failure modes hain: transient faults (Cause ID 3, 4, 8-13) khud clear ho jate hain, jabke latched faults (Cause ID 5, 6-7, 14) ko manual alarm reset chahiye.

solutions.en: Turn off the AC output switch and DC input switch, wait 5 minutes, then turn them on again.
solutions.ur: AC output switch aur DC input switch band karein, 5 minute intezaar karein, phir dobara on karein.

solutions.en: If the fault persists, contact your installer - do not keep power cycling the unit.
solutions.ur: Agar fault bana rahe to installer se rabta karein - unit ko baar baar power cycle na karein.

solutions.en: Record which Cause ID the app shows; 5, 6-7 and 14 need a manual alarm reset, not just a power cycle.
solutions.ur: Note karein ke app kaun sa Cause ID dikhata hai; 5, 6-7 aur 14 ko sirf power cycle nahi, manual alarm reset chahiye.

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Section 8.2 Table 8-2

meaning.en: The firmware upgrade did not complete normally. This manual grades it Major, unlike the M0 manual which grades it Minor.
meaning.ur: Firmware upgrade normally complete nahi hua. Ye manual ise Major grade karta hai, M0 manual Minor karta hai.

causes.en: The upgrade does not complete normally (Cause ID 1-4).
causes.ur: Upgrade normally complete nahi hota (Cause ID 1-4).

causes.en: The upgrade package files were modified, which breaks the RSA signature verification the SUN2000 upgrade procedure depends on.
causes.ur: Upgrade package ki files modify kar di gayi hain, jisse SUN2000 upgrade procedure ka RSA signature verification toot jata hai.

solutions.en: Perform the upgrade again using a supported USB flash drive and keep PV input disconnected during the retry.
solutions.ur: Supported USB flash drive se upgrade dohra karein aur retry ke dauran PV input disconnect rakhein.

solutions.en: Verify the upgrade package files were not modified - modification breaks RSA signature verification and the upgrade fails.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke upgrade package ki files modify nahi hui - modification se RSA signature verification toot-ta hai aur upgrade fail hota hai.

solutions.en: If the upgrade fails several times, contact your installer instead of retrying indefinitely.
solutions.ur: Agar kai baar fail ho to baar baar retry karne ke bajaye installer se rabta karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Section 8.2 Table 8-2

meaning.en: In Grid Connection with Zero Power mode or Power-limited Grid Connection Power mode, energy meter communication is interrupted.
meaning.ur: In Grid Connection with Zero Power ya Power-limited Grid Connection Power mode mein energy meter ki communication interrupt ho gayi.

causes.en: Energy meter communication interrupted in zero-power or power-limited grid connection mode (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Zero-power ya power-limited grid connection mode mein energy meter communication interrupt (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: RS485 A/B reversed or the meter's RS485 termination is missing.
causes.ur: RS485 A/B ulhe hue hain ya meter par RS485 termination missing hai.

solutions.en: Check that the energy meter model setting matches the actual model fitted on site.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke energy meter ka model setting site par lagi actual model se match karta hai.

solutions.en: Check that the preset communication parameters for the meter match the actual configuration.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke meter ke preset communication parameters actual configuration se match karte hain.

solutions.en: Check that the meter is powered on and the RS485 cable is connected correctly, then reseat the connectors.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke meter on hai aur RS485 cable theek connected hai, phir connectors dobara laga dein.

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Section 8.2 Table 8-2

meaning.en: Battery fault, interrupted battery communication, or the battery switch tripping while the inverter runs. Cause ID 2 (battery faulty) causes shutdown.
meaning.ur: Battery fault, battery communication interrupt, ya inverter chalte waqt battery switch trip. Cause ID 2 (battery faulty) par shutdown hota hai.

causes.en: The battery is faulty; battery communication is interrupted; battery switch trips when the SUN2000 is running (Cause ID 1, 3, 4).
causes.ur: Battery faulty hai; battery communication interrupt; inverter chalte waqt battery switch trip (Cause ID 1, 3, 4).

causes.en: The battery is faulty and communication is interrupted (Cause ID 2) - this one causes shutdown.
causes.ur: Battery faulty aur communication interrupt (Cause ID 2) - isi se shutdown hota hai.

solutions.en: Check the FAULT indicator on the front of the battery pack; if it is ON or flashing, stop and inspect.
solutions.ur: Battery pack ke front par FAULT indicator check karein; agar ON ya flash ho raha ho to ruk kar inspect karein.

solutions.en: Verify the communication cable and power cable between SUN2000 and battery, and that communication parameters match the SUN2000 RS485 config.
solutions.ur: SUN2000 aur battery ke darmiyan communication cable aur power cable check karein, aur communication parameters SUN2000 ke RS485 config se match karte hain check karein.

solutions.en: Send a shutdown command on the app, then cycle battery switch -> AC output switch -> DC input switch, waiting 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: App par shutdown command bhejein, phir battery switch -> AC output switch -> DC input switch ka cycle karein, 5 minute intezaar ke saath.

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Section 8.2 Table 8-2

title.ur: Output overload (manually clear karna hota hai)

meaning.en: The inverter output is overloaded or short-circuited. Needs manual clearing after the cause is removed.
meaning.ur: Inverter output overloaded ya short-circuited hai. Wajah hatane ke baad manually clear karna hota hai.

causes.en: The device output is short-circuited.
causes.ur: Device ka output short-circuited hai.

causes.en: The connected device load exceeds the inverter's rated value - the manual lists this as a separate check from the short circuit.
causes.ur: Connected device ka load inverter ki rated value se zyada hai - manual ise short circuit se alag check ke tor par list karta hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then check with a multimeter whether the output circuit is short-circuited.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karein, phir multimeter se check karein ke output circuit short to nahi hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the connected device load exceeds the inverter's rated apparent power.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke connected device ka load inverter ki rated apparent power se zyada to nahi hai.

solutions.en: After fixing, clear the alarm manually in the app - a power cycle alone is not enough for this alarm.
solutions.ur: Theek karne ke baad app mein alarm manually clear karein - sirf power cycle is alarm ke liye kaafi nahi hai.

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Section 8.2 Table 8-2

meaning.en: PV array configuration does not meet requirements, or module output is reversely connected or short-circuited. Cause IDs spell out which rule is broken.
meaning.ur: PV array configuration requirements ke mutabiq nahi, ya module output ulti polarity se connected ya short hai. Cause IDs batate hain ke kaun sa rule toota hai.

causes.en: Total PV modules > 75 (ID1); modules per string > 25 (ID2); modules per string < 6 (ID3).
causes.ur: Total PV modules 75 se zyada (ID1); per string modules 25 se zyada (ID2); per string modules 6 se kam (ID3).

causes.en: Total PV strings > 2 (3.8/5/7.6 kW) or > 3 (9/10/11.4 kW) (ID4); module output reversely connected or short-circuited (ID5).
causes.ur: Total PV strings 2 se zyada (3.8/5/7.6 kW) ya 3 se zyada (9/10/11.4 kW) (ID4); module output ulti polarity se connected ya short (ID5).

solutions.en: Power off, then count total modules, modules per string and number of strings against the Cause ID limits listed above.
solutions.ur: Band karein, phir total modules, per string modules aur strings ki tadaad Cause ID limits ke mutabiq gin lein.

solutions.en: For ID5, wait for string current below 0.5 A, set DC SWITCH OFF, and correct polarity or the short before re-energising.
solutions.ur: ID5 ke liye string current 0.5 A se neeche hone ka intezaar karein, DC SWITCH OFF karein, aur dobara energise karne se pehle polarity ya short theek karein.

solutions.en: ID1-ID4 are design errors: reconfigure the array, then clear the alarm manually in the app.
solutions.ur: ID1-ID4 design errors hain: array dobara configure karein, phir app mein alarm manually clear karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Section 8.2 Table 8-2
